description:
Read a business's website (home page and up to three linked pages) and return a draft knowledge base: basic_info, up to 15 faqs and other_info. Nothing is saved: show the draft to the user, fix what is wrong, then save it with create_knowledge_base (pass source_url along). Takes 10 to 60 seconds. Not charged; 5, then one a minute.

Requires scope `knowledge_bases:write`.

url.description: The website to read, e.g. https://example.com

name: import_knowledge_base
title: Draft a knowledge base from a website
